title: Avila Core Capability Probe v0.1 draft
description: The hash-only setup report `avila-core capabilities` prints: for each capability a case package binds, the expected executable digest, the local candidate files offered, and each candidate's state. Probing hashes bytes and never executes a candidate; a satisfied report is not a run authorization — the check and run paths verify the chosen bytes again against the package's pinned identities.

case.description: Path of the package manifest the probe read.

probedCapability.description: One capability the package binds, with every candidate offered for it. satisfied is true only when at least one candidate's bytes hashed to the pinned digest.

candidate.description: One offered file. verified: its bytes hash to the pinned digest. mismatch: its bytes hash to something else. missing: the path cannot be read as a regular file, so no digest exists to compare. The state vocabulary is the run path's capability check states.

sha256.description: The candidate's own digest when it could be read; absent for a missing candidate.
